# LZNT1 Windows oracle

`lznt1_windows.bin` was generated locally with Windows `ntdll!RtlCompressBuffer`
(`COMPRESSION_FORMAT_LZNT1`, 4096-byte blocks). It contains only synthetic bytes,
not evidence data or third-party corpus content.

The 16,384 input bytes are generated for each index `i` as:
`i % 17` when `(i / 4096) % 3 == 0`, otherwise the low byte of
`i ^ (i >> 4) ^ (i >> 9)` (integer division). The decoder test reconstructs
this input independently and covers the changing token length/offset split.

## WOF independent codec vectors

`wof_xpress_{4096,8192,16384}.bin` were generated by Windows
`ntdll!RtlCompressBuffer(COMPRESSION_FORMAT_XPRESS_HUFF=4, chunk_size=4096)`.
Input is the indicated prefix length of `b"LovelyCarve WOF XPRESS oracle 0123456789\n" * 1000`.
SHA-256 respectively: `6ed013226e6af4aaa02c5fdeee4e3a004378e65586dfa93aad0cd8ccefa61394`,
`ab823fa74cc5e4373c89b9a94736a3d212d30ad939136b5396697cbbf5b5c1c6`,
`6954a05b036b3b49854b37a2b5e21028c06f7030241a29472d799f5a588520f7`.

`wof_lzx_{4096,32768}.bin` are the `encoded-window15-level1-size*-phrase`
records extracted from [ms-compress's original-C oracle](https://github.com/CaddyGlow/ms-compress/blob/main/tests/fixtures/generate_lzx_oracle.py),
generated and decoded by wimlib revision `cd5e231c348c255ae5088873b5a66ee0eb96fa07`.
Input is the indicated prefix of repeated `b"native WIM LZX compressed block\n"`.
SHA-256 respectively: `1383bccbad5984aefa6633f8b33827ca23a539670440d482baeb82bd18228700`,
`486c152560f94e0f2c1f5f70cab15a6133bcc2d5e9719dae87c593cc5e85aea0`.
Upstream corpus SHA-256: `eefbc7b876d3f04b2c323f764c1e424be780ab721fedf48387b3b887c32e0e4a`.
Only generated phrase vectors are retained, not the GPL libFuzzer corpus.

`capability_tests.rs` reconstructs inputs independently, wraps the vectors in
synthetic WOF NTFS records, combines compressed/stored/partial chunks, and
compares full, ranged, streamed and MIME sampling paths. No evidence bytes
are checked into these fixtures.
